arxiv-2507-01413.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities as autonomous agents with rapidly expanding applications in various domains. pmc-12391732.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Infant nutrition plays a pivotal role in shaping short‐ and long‐term health outcomes.
